answer: Ask what a clone farm cannot buy in bulk, and the answer points at signed martial arts instructor licence with martial arts association attestation. It requires a licence the martial arts association issued after grading and vetting, so the dune of scaling up is a queue of real-world chores. Clones stop being profitable the moment each one needs its own proof. The ferrous is the margin: one proof is cheap, a hundred proofs are a business that loses money. The vault is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
